Only line-ending normalization notices were emitted.

performance.focusedLifecycleCharacterization: 15.76 seconds for one real-scene test covering initial 180 frames plus edit, save-load, reset, and model-switch phases
performance.claim: No representative frame-time, edit latency, dirty-chunk rebuild, memory, or snapshot-size profile was run. The focused lifecycle wall time is not a rebuild or performance pass. The predecessor 51.9392 ms safety failure remains unresolved and is not attributed to SG-VX-01.

manualAcceptance.observedFailure: User fell through the map immediately on the first play attempt.
manualAcceptance.reproduction: After 180 physics frames the real player reached Y=-77.306 below authoritative surface Y=15.000.
manualAcceptance.rootCause: Hollow concave trimesh collision was ray-hittable but unsuitable as CharacterBody ground.
manualAcceptance.repair: Retain visual mesh; derive one HeightMapShape3D per chunk from the highest authoritative exposed surface.
route: walk and look around the generated finite terrain
left click several exposed blocks, including a visible edge or step
right click to place Wood and confirm collision changes
press F6 to save, make another edit, press F9 to load, and confirm the saved shape returns
press F7 to reset and confirm the original seeded world returns
acceptanceQuestions: Does removal and placement feel readable and responsive?
Does the terrain scale support a small contained Snow Globe world?
Are collision and block targeting understandable?
Is this foundation worth carrying into citizen and settlement integration?
